outcome: Sourced capability matrix and offline fake-host prototype distinguish documented Work host events, opaque subscribed-chat binding and actual rendered replies. Current installed SDK cannot advertise the required Events protocol.
limitations: No actual callback, OAuth account, host subscription, app-server process/control socket, thread access or rendered reply was exercised.
The finite fake address set is not a production address classifier or proof of real DNS/TLS connection pinning. Injected authorization and map storage are synthetic.
Signing interoperability with an official host/external library, production storage/rotation, protocol pagination/replay, concurrency and live client qualification remain unrun.
Current Worker capability schemas, SDK pins and production routes remain unchanged. A separate callback-secret and protocol-compatibility design is required before production implementation.
PWA/in-app reminder alternatives remain separate from originating-chat delivery.
